resources.string: To let ServerBox use /sdcard/%1$s, open the “%1$s” folder and tap “Use this folder”.
ServerBox was not given access to /sdcard/%1$s.
That folder does not contain /sdcard/%1$s, so ServerBox still cannot use it.
ServerBox can only use folders on internal shared storage.
This device has no folder picker, so ServerBox cannot ask for access to shared storage.
